column2: Pah! You are lying - but I will not take this further.
Spouse visit
All port counties experience tax collecting issues\n

[target_spouse.GetTitledName], the [target_spouse.GetHusbandWife] of [target_ruler.GetTitledName], has been spending a few days in [capital.GetName]. It has been a very nice experience meeting [target_spouse.GetHerHim] - maybe our peoples are not that different after all.

Dear [target_ruler.GetTitledName],
During your [target_ruler.GetHusbandWifeOpp]'s recent visit to [capital.GetName] we had a great time discussing the similarities between our people. I suggest a non-aggression pact between us for the near future, and we will welcome any visitors from your realm with open arms.

Kind regards,
[From.GetTitledFirstName]

Dear [Root.GetTitledName],

If this agreement can lead to a better understanding between our peoples, I will put effort into opening our borders to visitors from your realm.

Yours truly,
 [target_ruler.GetTitledName].
I'll write to [target_ruler.GetTitledFirstName]. We could be friends.
Suggest a non-aggression pact.
It changes nothing.
A wonderful idea.
Sign the non-aggression pact.\n
Respectfully disagree.
Decline the offer.
Fantastic!
The pact is signed.

Dear [Root.GetTitledName],\n\nI am glad to hear you are well and that my [target_ruler.GetHusbandWifeOpp]'s visit was a good experience. Unfortunately, in these times pacts are broken left and right and to avoid going back on my word in the future, I would rather not give this kind of guarantee. I hope you understand.
That's a shame.

A petty noble from [target_ruler_capital.GetName] has spent a week visiting [capital.GetName], constantly bragging about his wealth and estates back home, insulting his local peers and behaving like royalty. Your courtiers are quite sick of him and are asking you to take action.
Write a formal complaint to [target_ruler.GetTitledName].
[target_ruler.GetTitledName] receives your letter of complaint.
Ignore your courtiers.
Your courtiers will not like this.
Make him go away...
Accidents happen all the time.

Dear [target_ruler.GetTitledName],
We are having some trouble with one of your petty nobles who is visiting [capital.GetName]. His behavior being unacceptable would be quite an understatement, and I will have to take action soon.

Best wishes,
[From.GetTitledName]
I must show sympathy and explain.
[From.GetFirstName] receives a letter expressing sympathy.
I will swallow my pride and take responsibility.
Let's not make it worse.
False accusations!
[From.GetFirstName] receives an angry letter.

Dear [Root.GetTitledName],
I'm sorry to hear about your annoying guest. I can assure you that he is not a noble from [target_ruler_capital.GetName]. If this scoundrel still remains in [capital.GetName], I hope you deal with it soon.

 Sincerely,
[From.GetTitledName]
Deal with impostor, and apologize.
Send a letter of apology to [From.GetTitledName]
I'm no fool, I can tell he's from [target_ruler_capital.GetName].
Break non-aggression pact.

Dear [Root.GetTitledName],
I feel insulted that the first thing you do is accuse my people of being ill-behaved. Did you ever consider that he may be a fraud? Of course not, you [GetFromRootInsult].

All the best,
[From.GetTitledName]
What nerve! This changes things.
I will let this go, for now.

My sincerest apologies [Root.GetTitledName], I realize that we made assumptions based on lies we were told and I hope this incident will soon be forgotten.

Kind regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
That's sorted then.

[Root.GetTitledName],
I should have known you would try to worm your way out of this matter. Responsibility never came easy to you, you [GetFromRootInsult]. Consider our agreement a thing of the past.

I hope you catch the plague,
[From.GetTitledName]
This is no friend of ours!

Dear [Root.GetTitledName],
I hope this person has not caused too much trouble. I will inform my people of your customs so that misunderstandings can be avoided when they visit your realm. Thank you for offering a chance to correct this behavior.

Best wishes,
[From.GetTitledName]
All is well.
As the war rages on, you find that your so-called ally, [ally_not_active_in_war.GetTitledNameWithNick], has been inactive for several years, not taking any offensive action to support you.
[ally_not_active_in_war.GetSheHeCap] has failed me for the last time.
I'll just pretend I didn't notice.

To the [GetFromRootInsult] [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
It pains me greatly to have to tell you that I have noticed the absence of your armies on the field of battle while the war is being fought by others. As I have no need for cowardly and treacherous allies, you may henceforth consider our alliance void.

With the hope of your speedy demise,
[From.GetTitledName]
I never...

Pirates have been marauding in increasing numbers all along the coast of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] recently. Worse, there is a rumor among the common folk that the pirates are being aided by [pirate_alliance_friction_ally.PrimaryTitle.GetAdjective] agents.
I must send a letter to the [pirate_alliance_friction_ally.PrimaryTitle.GetAdjective] [pirate_alliance_friction_ally.GetTitle] and find out if it so.

Dear [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

We are experiencing a plague of pirates on our coasts, and there is a rumor that you are supporting them. Can you please put my mind at ease regarding this, for I assume that it is not true. Or is it...?

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
I must reassure [From.GetHerHim].
A strange accusation. [From.GetSheHeCap] is up to something...

Dear [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

It grieves me to hear of your troubles. However, I can assure you that I have nothing to do with the pirates that plague your coasts.

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
Ah, that puts my mind at rest.
[From.GetSheHeCap] lies!

[Root.GetTitledFirstName],
You are a [GetFromRootInsult] and a liar and I will have you know that our pact has been broken through no fault of mine but through your treacherous actions.

May your days be filled with deserved misery,
[From.GetTitledName]
The [GetRootFromInsult]!

[Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I must say I do not approve of the tone in your last letter. Accusing others to try and obscure your own failings in keeping your realm safe only leaves you looking like a [GetFromRootInsult].

I wish you a speedy recovery from your paranoia,
[From.GetTitledName]
Oh dear... I should try to repair this...
The [GetRootFromInsult] is hiding something!

Esteemed [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

It distresses me that you perceived my earlier letter as accusing you and questioning your honor, as that was not my intention. Please accept my sincerest apologies for this misunderstanding, and rest assured that I do not suspect you of involvement in piracy.

With hopes of continued friendship,
[From.GetTitledName]
I see now that [From.GetHerHis] intentions were honorable.
I must distance myself from this [GetRootFromInsult] snake.

Dear [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

I accept your apology and look forward to many more years of continued good relations.

With my kindest regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
It is all good, then.

Dear [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Lamentably, your words of apology do not ring true. I am no fool, and a trust that has been broken cannot be repaired with mere empty words. I cannot maintain a pact under such circumstances.

With scant pleasure,
[From.GetTitledName]
Very well, if it must be so.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Your aggressive words only serve to strengthen my suspicions regarding your low character and propensity to underhanded dealings. Clearly you planning some dark deed. I demand that you cease at once.

With reluctant regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
I should back down before this breaks our relationship.
May the cur choke on [From.GetHerHis] foul tongue!

Dear [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
You are quite right that I have erred in my ways. However, after pondering my faults and considering what a [GetFromRootCompliment] you are, I am now fully committed to seeing you prosper and to preserve our good relationship. I convey to you my sincere and humble apologies.

With the greatest respect and admiration,
[From.GetTitledName]
Ah, very well then.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName],

You are the worst kind of scum to frame and then attack in such a vile way those who have been so loyal and steadfast towards you. You are a [GetFromRootInsult] and I would not wish upon anyone the misfortune of making pacts or agreements with you.

Sincerely and disappointedly,
[From.GetTitledName]
[From.GetFirstName] should stay out of my business.
[From.GetTitledName] seemed very grateful for my help, and promised to return the favor whenever possible.
I'm glad it worked out for them.
[From.GetTitledName] was upset that I interrupted a private discussion, [From.GetSheHe] wanted me to stay out of their business in the future.
[From.GetTitledName] should be grateful for my help!

Upon the conclusion of a long council meeting you decide to make a toast. Of course, one toast eventually becomes many and time seems to slip away... Later, as you leave the council chamber, you stumble and fall on your face. You can feel the taste of blood in your mouth and dizzyness is setting in.
Help!
Hopefully someone will hear you.
No need to draw attention to myself right now, I think.

[From.GetTitledName] just left the council meeting but now you can hear a faint call for help. As you go outside you notice [From.GetTitledName] laying flat on [From.GetHerHis] face and all bloodied up. [From.GetSheHeCap] asks you for aid, and to be discreet.
Help [From.GetHerHim] discreetly.
You do the honorable thing.
Call the others out and mock [From.GetHerHim].
You hear the voice of [From.GetTitledFirstName] just before you pass out. As you wake up the next morning, it feels as if your head is about to explode. But at least you are safe.
I am in debt to [From.GetTitledFirstName].

You notice [From.GetTitledName] standing next to you, [From.GetSheHe] seems to contemplate helping but is not responding to your pleads. Just before you pass out you see [From.GetHerHim] bringing the rest of the councilors out, and they look at you in pity before they help you.
I'll remember this.

Your vassal [target_vassal.GetTitledName] is arguing with [target_vassal.GetHerHis] [target_vassal.GetHusbandWifeOpp]. [target_vassal.GetSheHeCapOpp] seems quite upset and they are almost screaming at each other. They don't even notice that you are watching them.
I should intervene.
It's none of my business.
My [Root.GetHusbandWifeOpp] and I were arguing violently about insignificant matters but [From.GetTitledName] came to my rescue and my marriage may be saved because of that.
I owe [From.GetHerHim] a favor.

The crooked [pardon_target.GetBestName] has called in the Favor you owe [pardon_target.GetHerHim] in order to force you to pardon [pardon_target.GetHerHis] devious crimes! You will no longer be able to take hostile actions against [pardon_target.GetHerHim] without looking like a tyrant in the eyes of the realm.
Forgive and forget.
A letter is sent to [ally_not_active_in_war.GetTitledNameWithNick].
Answer cordially.
Answer accusingly.
Answer soothingly.
Answer and accept apology.
Break the pact with [From.GetTitledName].
Admit to wrongdoing and send apology.
Good riddance!

Being on your liege's council is not always easy. You have a huge amount of work that needs attention and there is so much to do. The list seems endless. Just as you are about to give up, [target_help_councillor.GetTitledFirstName] steps through the door and asks if you want any help. As tempting it may be, you would be in [target_help_councillor.GetHerHis] debt for it.
I suppose I could use some help...
No! I can manage!

When casually strolling around the premises, as one often do, you come across [From.GetTitledFirstName] sitting at [From.GetHerHis] desk, overburdened with work. Seeing this as the perfect opportunity to help [From.GetHerHim] out and perhaps gain a favor in return, you offer a helping hand. [From.GetSheHeCap] looks at you with heavy eyes and after a moment, decides to accept your offer!
I wasn't doing anything important anyway.

When casually strolling around the premises, as one often do, you come across [From.GetTitledFirstName] sitting at [From.GetHerHis] desk, overburdened with work. You see this as a great opportunity to help [From.GetHerHim] out and gain a favor in return. But to your surprise, [From.GetSheHe] not only refuses your help but has the nerve to insult you for it!
Ha! Well good luck with that work of yours!

Every ruler needs to go out and meet the peasants in person from time to time. Just to make sure that they know you still exist if nothing else. As you visit the locals of [helping_vassal.Capital.GetName], you speak very frankly about what you think of them. Something that they took great offense in it seems. You look back to ensure that your guards are there to keep you out of harm's way, only to notice that they have all gone into the local tavern! Before you know it, the peasants begin to throw things at you!
I could run to [helping_vassal.GetTitledFirstName] and hide there!
Run for safety at the nearby residence of [helping_vassal.GetTitledFirstName] and hope that [helping_vassal.GetSheHe] will help.
Maybe I can just outrun them?
[Root.GetTitledName] getting away safely

You are calmly minding your own business, when you suddenly hear an awful ruckus outside. You open the door to see [From.GetTitledFirstName] running towards you with a mob of angry peasants at [From.GetHerHis] heels! If you would offer [From.GetHerHim] a place to hide, [From.GetSheHe] would truly be in your debt.
Quickly! Over here!
I'm not getting involved in this!

As you get closer you can see [From.GetTitledFirstName] standing in a doorway waving at you! You hurry towards [From.GetHerHim] and once inside, [From.GetFirstName] quickly closes the door. Safe at last. Who would ever have thought that peasants would be so easily insulted?
Thank you! I owe you one.

Running as fast as you possibly could, you see [From.GetTitledFirstName] standing in a doorway. But instead of offering you a safe place to hide, [From.GetSheHe] quickly closes the door right in front of you! Leaving you to fend for yourself!
Why that little...

While passing judgement onto criminals from the safety of your throne, a young noble is brought before you. You quickly come to the conclusion that the man is indeed guilty. Condemning him might not be the wisest choice, as he is of noble birth. If you were to pardon the man he might prove himself useful to you, as he would be in your debt.
Release him! Now, do not forget what I did for you...
Being of noble birth means nothing. To the dungeons with him!

During a particularly heated argument in the council, [target_saved_voter.GetTitledFirstName] stepped in as you were about to make a fool out of yourself. [target_saved_voter.GetSheHeCap] was able to argue for your point, not only saving your face but also winning the argument for you! It is obvious that [target_saved_voter.GetFirstName]'s smooth talking was the sole reason for your success, and denying that fact would likely paint you in a bad light.
Thank you! I do truly owe you in return!
Bah! I would have won that argument by myself!

During a particularly heated argument in the council, you stepped in as [From.GetBestName] was making a fool of [From.GetHerselfHimself]. You managed to soothe the debaters and win the argument for [From.GetHerHim]. This turned out to be a great move on your part, as [From.GetSheHe] now feels indebted to you!
Now, when to call in the favor...

During a particularly heated argument in the council, you stepped in as [From.GetBestName] was making a fool of [From.GetHerselfHimself]. You managed to soothe the debaters and win the argument for [From.GetHerHim]. Though this only infuriated [From.GetHerHim], as [From.GetSheHe] wanted to win the argument by [From.GetHerHis] own means! Throwing a tantrum like this has publicly shamed [From.GetFirstName].
Ingratitude is the world's reward.

As the council meeting ends, [target_pious_voter.GetTitledFirstName] pulls you to the side. [target_pious_voter.GetSheHeCap] talks to you at length about the need to respect the authority of [Root.Religion.GetScriptureName] when making decisions in the council. Apparently the council is in agreement on you having neglected to do so, but fortunately [target_pious_voter.GetFirstName] offers to help you!
You would do that for me? I am in your debt!
No, there is no place for [Root.Religion.GetScriptureName] in politics!

The council agreed that [From.GetBestName] had been acting in a very impious way, ignoring many wisdoms of [Root.Religion.GetScriptureName]. Being a pious [Root.GetManWoman] you decided to help [From.GetHerHim] not repeat the same mistakes. [From.GetFirstName] was very grateful for this help, and told you that [From.GetSheHe] was in your debt!
Excellent, I can make use of this favor.

The council agreed that [From.GetBestName] had been acting in a very impious way, ignoring many wisdoms of [Root.Religion.GetScriptureName]. Being a pious [Root.GetManWoman] you decided to help [From.GetHerHim] not repeat the same mistake. Though, [From.GetFirstName] was infuriated by what [From.GetSheHe] assumed to be you trying to trick [From.GetHerHim]!
No better than a heretic...

Word has reached you of a [target_foreign_voter.GetJobTitle] in a foreign realm who is of masterful skill and handles [target_foreign_voter.GetHerHis] tasks with ease. Seeing as your own abilities are often doubted by the rest of the Council, perhaps you should write a letter to this '[target_foreign_voter.GetBestName]' and ask for [target_foreign_voter.GetHerHis] advice?
Yes, I will write [target_foreign_voter.GetHerHim]!
No, why bother...

To the masterful [Root.GetTitledFirstName],
I am [From.GetTitledFirstName], [From.GetJobTitle] of [From.Liege.GetTitledFirstName].
Your skill as a [Root.GetJobTitle] on the Council of [Root.Liege.GetTitledFirstName] is known far and wide. I implore you to advise me in matters of politics, so that I may serve my liege as admirably as you serve yours.

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
A touching request, I will help you!
Fraternizing with the enemy? I think not!

To the [GetFromRootCompliment] [Root.GetFirstName],

I agree to lend you advice on how to serve on the Council more effectively. Along with this letter I have enclosed a book which treatise my own experience as a [From.GetJobTitle], I hope its contents will serve you well!

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
Truly a great [From.GetManWoman]!

To the [GetFromRootInsult] [Root.GetFirstName],

Do you really think I would convey my secrets to you? You are a pathetic [From.GetJobTitle] and I do not see that changing soon!

Sincerely,
[From.GetTitledName]
I was foolish to ask...
Why the...! [From.GetSheHeCap] dares to insult me when I ask for help?
Perhaps some money will change [From.GetHerHis] tone?

To the [GetFromRootCompliment] [Root.GetFirstName],

Know that I will never forget what you did for me! Please do not hesitate to ask if there is anything I can do for you, and know I will treat you like the dearest of friends.

Sincerely,
[From.GetTitledName]
Perfect!

To [Root.GetTitledFirstName],

Know that I asked out of curiosity and not malice, but even so I apologize for what I did.
Sincerely,

[From.GetTitledName]
Perhaps I was too harsh in my response...

To the [GetFromRootInsult] [Root.GetFirstName],

You dare to refuse me help? Know that I will not soon forget this insult to my honor.

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Truly a fool...

To the [GetFromRootCompliment] [Root.GetFirstName],

I excuse my forward request. Perhaps some gold would make you reconsider my offer?

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
Well, when you put it like that!
No amount of gold will help your cause.

To the [GetFromRootCompliment] [Root.GetFirstName],

I excuse my previous behavior! Along with this letter I have enclosed a book which treatise my own experience as a [From.GetJobTitle], I hope its contents will serve you well!

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
I knew some gold would loosen [From.GetHerHis] tongue!

To the [GetFromRootInsult] [Root.GetFirstName],

Did you really think that I could be bought? Take your money back and leave me be, you will never partake of my secrets!

Signed,
[From.GetTitledName]
It was worth a try...!

Your friend, [target_unlanded_friend.GetTitledFirstName], does not stand to inherit any land of [target_unlanded_friend.GetHerHis] own. You have always considered [target_unlanded_friend.GetHerHim] a [GetRootFromCompliment], and as such it would be a shame to see [target_unlanded_friend.GetHerHim] fade into irrelevance. If you were to offer [target_unlanded_friend.GetHerHim] the [target_friend_land.GetFullName] it would not only bring your friend closer, but you would also gain a vassal your entire family could trust!
I shall offer [target_unlanded_friend.GetHerHim] land!
Alas, [target_unlanded_friend.GetFirstName] was never meant to rule...

It is clear to you that [Root.Liege.GetTitledFirstName]'s commanders are nothing more than rabble - all brawn and no finesse. You, on the other hand, are an experienced tactician and a great teacher to boot! Perhaps you should offer to train [Root.Liege.GetFirstName]'s commanders in the hopes of gaining [Root.Liege.GetHerHis] favor?
I shall send [Root.Liege.GetHerHim] a letter offering my services!
It is not worth it.

To my liege, the [GetFromRootCompliment] [Root.GetFirstName],
It has not escaped me that several of your commanders lack formal training in military tactics. I would like to offer my services by training [commander_one.GetFirstName], [commander_two.GetFirstName] and [commander_three.GetFirstName] in the use of advanced battlefield stratagems!

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
A most generous offer, for this I will owe [From.GetHerHim]!
No! [From.GetSheHeCap] is just trying to gain leverage on me!

To my loyal subject, the [GetFromRootCompliment] [Root.GetFirstName],

Your offer is most generous! I graciously accept your offer and will remember this good deed in the future.

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
Excellent! Now I have leverage on [From.GetHerHim]...

To my subject, the [GetFromRootInsult] [Root.GetFirstName],

Your offer is obviously nothing but thinly-veiled deception. That you would even suggest that my commanders are anything but the very best is an insult!

Regards,
[From.GetTitledName]
This was not what I meant to happen!
